description.value: Tap and Barrel Brentwood is part of a seven-location BC restaurant group with a strong focus on local craft beer, BC wine, and comfort food made with seasonal ingredients. Located in the Brentwood neighbourhood of Burnaby, the restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating. The group is known for its extensive BC-only tap selections and rotating menus developed in partnership with local breweries and wineries.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (22 spaces, covered) at 68m; stands (32 spaces, covered) at 85m; rack (3 spaces) at 93m; rack (6 spaces) at 98m. Total: 63 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Brentwood location exists and is active, matching the OSM address (4580 Brentwood Blvd #012-11, Burnaby, BC V5C 0K3) and phone (16046375204). Takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'ORDER TAKEOUT & DELIVERY' link across all pages. The menu page explicitly offers a 'Filter our menu by diet' option, indicating dietary accommodation. No evidence found on the website for bike parking, Wi-Fi (mentioned only for other locations), or washrooms at this specific location.
concerns: Website content was truncated before showing the full 'What You'll Love' section for the Brentwood location, so location-specific amenities (e.g. patio details, Wi-Fi) could not be confirmed. Other locations list Free WiFi but this was not confirmed for Brentwood.
OSM name is 'Tap and Barrel' but the website consistently uses 'Tap & Barrel' with an ampersand.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food, drink, and takeout in Burnaby.

wow_evidence: seven-location BC restaurant group with a strong focus on local craft beer, BC wine
